title: Order of Play on the First Tee
question: How is the order of play for players decided on the first tee?

choices.text: The order is taken from the list of tee times (the draw)
The order is based on who arrived first

explanation: On the first tee, player order is based on the official draw or tee time list provided by the organisers.

juniorVersion.title: Who Goes First on the First Tee?
juniorVersion.question: How do we find out who hits first when starting on the first tee?

choices.text: We follow the list of tee times that shows who goes first
The players pick together who goes first
The player who gets to the tee first goes first
Whoever has the lowest handicap goes first

juniorVersion.explanation: On the first tee, we use the list that says the order for everyone to tee off. This list is made by the people running the event.

vocabulary.simpleMeaning: The time you are told to start playing
A number that shows how good a golfer is
The place where you start your round of golf

juniorVersion.teachingTip: Show the players the tee time list at the start of a round so they can see who goes first.
likelyMisconceptions: Kids may think they can always pick who goes first with their friends.
Some might believe that being first to arrive means going first.
